newsitem.title: USA: Newriders names former PepsiCo exec CEO.
newsitem.headline: Newriders names former PepsiCo exec CEO.

text.p: Newriders Inc said Tuesday it named John Martin, formerly of PepsiCo Inc, as its chairman and chief executive officer.
Martin replaces Michael Purcell, who became president.
"I'm relinquising my position to a man who has a just a tad more experience than I do," Purcell told Reuters.
Martin, who served as Taco Bell's chief executive and chairman from 1983 to October 1996, most recently was chief executive of PepsiCo Casual Dining, Purcell said.
Newriders operates Easyriders Cafes in Fresno, Calif., and Myrtle Beach, S.C.
